svg.title: Decentering creates an asymmetric vector field
svg.desc: Analytic tangential displacement arrows for p1 equal to 0.004 and p2 equal to negative 0.003, exaggerated twenty-two times.
svg.text: Decentering creates an asymmetric vector field
Dimensionless normalized coordinates. The arrow lengths are exaggerated uniformly by a factor of 22.
